cards.answer: An open-source framework for the whole AI development lifecycle: classical ML, ML pipelines and AI agents (also acting as an MLOps tool).

cards.prompt: Order the three pipelines for putting an ML workflow into production in ZenML.
cards.answer: Feature engineering, then training, then inference.

cards.prompt: What does the feature engineering pipeline do?
cards.answer: Splits the dataset into train and test sets and bakes it into a training-ready dataset.

cards.prompt: During training in ZenML, you can track metrics and metadata by calling `.____()`.
In ZenML, what does a pipeline contain?
Your trained model beats the older one and you want it in production. In ZenML, what is the described way?
cards.answer: Promote the best model to production with a single command, after the training pipeline has evaluated and saved it.

cards.prompt: ZenML can only be used for classical ML, not AI agents.
cards.answer: Myth: it supports classical ML, pipelines and AI agents.
